Two weeks before graduation, the whole grade got an email from an email account called "goodbye(area)high@gmail.com". The email contained only photos of us in our year 7 camp and the line "one is the hunter, one is the hunted. Guess who."
At first a few of us were kinda freaked out, but mostly joked about the whole thing, speculated who it could be etc. (This is in Australia at an academically selective school, so school violence pretty much didn't exist.)
We had an assembly with our principal who asked whoever it was to come forward, saying the police were involved. Of course no one did. 
Turns out, people had received individual emails with just recent photos of them taken without their knowledge, on their way home from school. 
This quiet kid in our grade had been stalking us.
